About

Learning through
software projects.

I'm a corporate banking analyst in New York. Outside work, I build software projects to learn how technology products are planned, built, and maintained, including the tradeoffs and checks behind each decision. I'm interested in how technology companies build and run their products, and these projects are how I'm learning that side of the work.

I use AI tools, mainly Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code, for much of the implementation. Each project page separates what I decided and did from what I used AI tools for and how they produced it, and records who ran each check.
